notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE!
notes.content:
MAJOR UPDATE!

I'm happy to announce a major update bringing several improvements based on players feedbacks:

Most levels have been redesigned to improve gaming experience and difficulty balance.
The overall game speed (chat logs and gameplay) has been increased.


*WARNING*
This update affects the game a lot. If you've already started the game and want to keep playing it as it was before the update, DON'T download it.

notes.title: Gameplay Update - Two levels updated (HBNews network)
notes.content:
The update makes two levels (servers) of HBNews (the first network) easier to beat. If you are more into challenging levels, don't worry: there are going to be a lot later ;)

"HBNews File Server" level updates:
- Max Alarm Level has been increased to 100 (from 50).
- Link Point (Copy Function) has been moved to another tile. Now you're not forced to destroy the enemy to get the Copy Function.
- Memory size has been reduced to 8 slots (from 12).

"HBNews Database Server" level update:
- Max Alarm Level has been increased to 100 (from 35).

notes.title: Leak Elite Coming January 14th
notes.content:
I'm really happy to annouce that Leak Elite will be available on January 14th!

+++ RELEASE NOTES +++
********************************************************************************************

* Windows is the only supported platform at the moment. Other platforms could be supported in the future.
* Dialogue and Tutorial text is available in English, Italian and Spanish (other languages could be available in the future). UI text is available only in English.
* Steam Cloud is supported.
* Eight achievements, named after famous hackers or hacker groups.

********************************************************************************************

The video section in the Community Hub contains a complete walkthrough and other gameplay videos you can watch to understand how the game works.

I hope you will enjoy Leak Elite from January the 14th!
